exec azk init --label first
exec azk key generate k --type ed25519
exec azk slot list
stdout 'passphrase +first'

# Add a second passphrase, unlock with it, remove the first.
exec azk slot add passphrase --label second --new-passphrase-file=new.txt
stdout 'Added passphrase slot'
exec azk --json slot list
stdout '"label": "second"'
! exec azk slot remove nope
stderr 'not found'
env AZK_PASSPHRASE=
exec azk --passphrase-file=new.txt sign --key k --in new.txt
exec azk --passphrase-file=new.txt slot remove first
exec azk slot list
! stdout first
stdout second
! exec azk --passphrase-file=old.txt sign --key k --in new.txt
stderr 'does not unlock'
! exec azk --passphrase-file=new.txt slot remove second
stderr 'last slot'
exec azk --passphrase-file=new.txt audit tail
stdout 'slot.add'
stdout 'slot.remove'

-- new.txt --
second passphrase
-- old.txt --
correct horse
